name: Experimental Broadcast
description: A grime-centric club night shaped by raw textures and weighty low-end frequencies. Moving through breakbeat, drum & bass, footwork, and beyond, the program brings together forward-thinking artists exploring fractured percussion and stripped-back, high-impact rhythms. Lineup features Renata, Sara Persico, Rubbishhh, Miri Malek, and Ammnejah. Doors 23:30.
